answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is non-transferable graded history: each identity must forge a ferrous-hard record of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Low-effort or duplicated work is treated as soft velvet that never hardens into standing. An attacker scanning the horizon of a large farm faces rising marginal cost because every new fake account requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without peer detection and slash.
